Prognica Labs is an award winning company working on AI based early detection and diagnosis of breast cancer, with a strong mission to democratize early detection, diagnosis and treatment of Breast Cancer by making it more accurate, accessible & affordable.
We have been at the forefront of bringing research, awareness, and economical and accessible screening solution to healthcare industry and the society.
